item.title: North Korea’s ‘Naegohyang’ Team Departs for North via China from Incheon Airport (北 ‘내고향’ 선수단 인천공항서 中 경유해 北으로)
item.description:
North Korea’s ‘Naegohyang’ Team Departs for North via China from Incheon Airport (北 ‘내고향’ 선수단 인천공항서 中 경유해 北으로)

The North Korean women’s club football team ‘Naegohyang Women’s Football Team,’ which visited South Korea on the 17th to participate in the 2025–2026 Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women’s Champions League (AWCL), will depart for Beijing from Incheon Airport at 3:30 PM on the 24th. <<> According to the Ministry of Unification on this day, the Naegohyang team will depart from Incheon Airport on an Air China flight to Beijing at 3:30 PM. After winning the semifinal against Suwon FC Women at Suwon General Sports Complex on the 17th, the Naegohyang team defeated Japan’s Tokyo Verdy Beleza in the final the previous day, the 23rd, to win the Asian Women’s Club Football Championship. <<> North Korean media reported on the Naegohyang team’s victory in the AFC Women’s Champions League final the previous day but made no mention of the match being held at Suwon General Sports Complex in Gyeonggi Province. There was also no mention of the ‘Joint Cheering Squad,’ composed of South Korean private organizations supported by 3 billion won from the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund, cheering for the Naegohyang team. <<> Initially, under AFC regulations stating that teams facing each other in the semifinals share the same accommodation, the Naegohyang team was set to stay at the same hotel as the Suwon FC Women squad. However, on the day of the Naegohyang team’s arrival in South Korea, the Suwon FC Women team moved to a different nearby hotel in Suwon. The ‘Joint Cheering Squad’ drew controversy during the semifinal match between Suwon FC and the Naegohyang team for cheering louder when Naegohyang scored or applauding when Suwon FC’s Ji So-yeon missed a penalty kick. Suwon FC Women’s head coach Park Ki-young said to reporters after losing the semifinal, “We are the South Korean women’s football team Suwon FC Women. I was very upset because of what happened in the opposite stands (the Joint Cheering Squad) during the match.” <<> The North Korean delegation entered South Korea on the 17th via Beijing, China, arriving at Incheon Airport. Upon entry, they left the airport without responding to any questions from reporters or greetings from those welcoming them. This visit to South Korea by a North Korean delegation was the first in about eight years since the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) World Tour Grand Finals held in Incheon in 2018. It was also the first since North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un defined inter-Korean relations as ‘hostile belligerent relations’ at the end of 2023. (지난 17일 2025-2026시즌 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스리그(AWCL) 경기 참가를 위해 방남(訪南)한 북한의 여자 클럽 축구팀 ‘내고향여자축구단’이 24일 오후 3시30분 인천공항에서 베이징으로 출국한다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: “Fighting to the People Power Party Candidates Joining Conservative Reconstruction, Do Well” (한동훈 “보수재건 공감하는 국힘 후보들 파이팅, 선전하시라”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon: “Fighting to the People Power Party Candidates Joining Conservative Reconstruction, Do Well” (한동훈 “보수재건 공감하는 국힘 후보들 파이팅, 선전하시라”)

Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, running in the Busan North Gap by-election for the National Assembly, said on the 24th, “Fighting to the People Power Party candidates who join in conservative reconstruction.” <<> Meeting with reporters at Unsusa Temple in Sasang-gu, Busan on Buddha’s Birthday, candidate Han stated, “There are many People Power Party candidates who desire a conservative reconstruction based on the constitution, facts, and common sense.” He added, “I hope the People Power Party candidates who join in conservative reconstruction will gain more strength and do well.” <<> This is interpreted as a remark targeting People Power Party Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook. On the 22nd, during a campaign support event for People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik, Supreme Council member Shin met Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and said, “Fighting, Ha Jung-woo” and “I hope you do well.” Candidate Han is seen as retorting with “Fighting to the People Power Party candidates.” <<> Referring to the People Power Party’s pro-power faction, candidate Han said, “With that line, conservatives will also lose the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election,” adding, “President Yoon might serve a second term (through constitutional amendment).” He continued, “Now, let’s overcome (internal conflicts) and fight together. I will take to heart the minds of those who fervently support me, those who don’t support me but say ‘still, you’re the only one,’ and those who ‘still dislike you.’” <<> Some in the opposition are also discussing the possibility of a pan-conservative election alliance in the Busan region. In fact, it is reported that among some People Power Party lawmakers in Busan, there are calls for “candidate Han to appeal for support for People Power Party candidates.” <<> A People Power Party lawmaker from Busan said, “It is true that the People Power Party’s momentum has stalled, especially in Western Busan, where the Democratic Party’s influence is strong,” adding, “To overturn the difficult landscape, an election alliance with independent candidate Han is desperately needed.” <<> People Power Party lawmaker Park Soo-young (re-elected, Busan Nam-gap) also wrote on the party’s lawmaker group chat on the 21st, “My district, Busan Nam-gu, is a place that wins by 10-15 percentage points (over the Democratic Party), but now it’s a narrow deficit,” adding, “We’re holding the line on the ground, but without ‘special measures’ from the Busan city party and the central party to change the game, the election will be difficult.” <<> Regarding the meaning of ‘special measures,’ an aide to lawmaker Park explained, “It was not made with a specific candidate’s withdrawal in mind,” adding, “We asked the party leadership to step in so that options like not just unification, but also candidate Han appealing for support for People Power Party candidates in Busan, could be pursued.” (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보가 24일 “보수 재건에 동참하는 국민의힘 후보들, 파이팅하시라”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Jae-myung and Kim Hye-kyung Inspect Baekun Valley in Pocheon Together (이재명·김혜경, 함께 포천 백운계곡 점검)
item.description:
Lee Jae-myung and Kim Hye-kyung Inspect Baekun Valley in Pocheon Together (이재명·김혜경, 함께 포천 백운계곡 점검)

President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung visited Baekun Valley in Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province, on the afternoon of the 24th, a holiday for Buddha's Birthday, after concluding their schedule in Andong, North Gyeongsang Province. They personally inspected the usage status of streams and valleys as well as summer safety management conditions. Baekun Valley in Pocheon is a place where President Lee had strongly promoted renovation projects during his tenure as Gyeonggi Province Governor. (이재명 대통령 부부가 부처님오신날 연휴인 24일 오후 경북 안동 일정을 마치고 경기 포천시 백운계곡을 찾아 하천·계곡 이용 실태와 여름철 안전 관리 상황을 직접 점검했다. 포천 백운계곡은 이 대통령이 경기도지사 재임 시절 강력하게 정비 사업을 했던 곳이다.)

According to the presidential office, Baekun Valley in Pocheon had been plagued by over 1,600 illegal facilities and rampant illegal business activities, such as arbitrary seating fees. Through persistent communication and persuasion with merchant associations and others during his time as governor, President Lee pushed for renovations, and it has now been transformed into a clean rest area accessible to everyone, the presidential office explained. (청와대에 따르면, 과거 포천 백운계곡은 1600여 개의 불법 시설이 난립하고 고무줄 자릿세 등 불법 영업 행위가 성행했었다. 이 대통령은 도지사 시절 상인조합 등과의 끈질긴 소통과 설득을 통해 정비를 추진했고, 현재는 누구나 자유롭게 이용할 수 있는 청정 휴식 공간으로 탈바꿈했다는 게 청와대의 설명이다.)

A citizen who came from Namyangju that day expressed gratitude, saying, "The water is great, and I've visited often since I was young. But from a few years ago, I can enjoy it comfortably without paying seating fees, so I come every year." Other citizens also said, "Thank you for making the country great," and "I watch you daily on YouTube." (이날 남양주에서 왔다는 한 시민은 “물이 좋아 어릴 때부터 자주 왔는데, 몇 년 전부터는 자릿세를 내지 않고 편하게 즐길 수 있어 매년 찾고 있다”며 감사의 뜻을 전했다. 다른 시민들도 “나라를 훌륭하게 만들어줘서 감사하다” “유튜브로 매일 보고 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee personally greeted children playing in the valley who waved and cheered. In particular, he grabbed the wet hand of a child showing off a plastic bottle containing tadpoles and said, "Oh, it's cold!" with a bright smile. First Lady Kim Hye-kyung also approached citizens, asking, "Is there anything inconvenient?" and "Stay healthy," and kindly asked the children, "Did you eat something delicious?" (이 대통령은 계곡에서 물놀이를 하던 아이들이 손을 흔들며 환호하자 일일이 인사를 나눴다. 특히 올챙이가 담긴 페트병을 자랑하는 아이의 젖은 손을 잡으며 “앗 차갑다”고 환하게 웃어 보이기도 했다. 김혜경 여사 역시 시민들에게 “불편한 것은 없으시냐” “건강하시라”고 안부를 묻고, 아이들에게 “맛있는 것 먹었니?”라며 친근하게 다가갔다.)

The presidential couple shook hands with merchants around the valley to gauge the on-site economic conditions. When President Lee asked, "It's getting hotter, but are sales going well? How do you operate in the winter?" one merchant explained the situation, saying, "In winter, the Baekun Valley Winter Festival is held, drawing many citizens." (이 대통령 부부는 계곡 주변 상인들과도 악수하며 현장 경기 체감도를 살폈다. 이 대통령이 “날씨가 더워지는데 장사가 잘되는지, 겨울철에는 어떻게 운영하는지” 묻자, 한 상인은 “겨울에는 백운계곡 동장군 축제가 열려 시민들이 많이 찾는다”고 현황을 설명했다.)

President Lee told merchants and citizens, "If you need anything, feel free to request support anytime," and added, "If there are things that need improvement or maintenance, let me know, and I'll have the Minister of the Interior and Safety take care of it." (이 대통령은 상인과 시민들에게 “필요한 것이 있으면 언제든 지원 요청을 해달라”며 “시설 보완이나 정비 등 필요한 부분을 말씀하시면 행정안전부 장관에게 챙기라고 하겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee walked along the wooden deck path above the valley, carefully examining the risk of valley flooding due to heavy summer rains and the management status of hazardous facilities. He especially paused in front of a neglected sledding slope nearby to conduct a focused on-site inspection. (이 대통령은 계곡 위 나무 데크길을 도보로 이동하며 여름철 집중호우로 인한 계곡 범람 위험성과 위험 시설 관리 상태를 꼼꼼히 들여다봤다. 특히 인근에 방치된 눈썰매장 앞에서는 잠시 걸음을 멈추고 현장 상황을 집중 점검했다.)

After completing the on-site inspection, President Lee called the Minister of the Interior and Safety and instructed, "Expand cleaning staff support around the valley ahead of summer and significantly strengthen safety management," urging special attention. This aligns with his previous emphasis at a Cabinet meeting that "although natural disasters cannot be fundamentally prevented, the damage can be greatly reduced through the government's dedication and efforts." (현장 점검을 마친 이 대통령은 행정안전부 장관에게 전화를 걸어 “여름철을 앞두고 계곡 주변의 청소 인력 지원을 확대하고, 안전 관리를 대폭 강화하라”고 지시하며 각별히 신경 쓸 것을 당부했다. 전날 국무회의에서 “자연재해를 근원적으로 막을 수는 없지만 정부의 정성과 노력으로 피해는 얼마든지 줄일 수 있다”고 강조한 기조의 연장선이다.)

Meanwhile, after communicating with citizens, the presidential couple visited a restaurant in a commercial building at the valley entrance with their aides, sharing a dinner of chicken stew and acorn jelly to conclude their on-site visit to Pocheon. (한편, 시민들과 소통을 마친 이 대통령 부부는 참모진과 함께 계곡 입구의 한 상가 식당에 들러 닭볶음탕과 도토리묵 등으로 저녁 식사를 함께하며 포천 현장 방문 일정을 마무리했다.)

item.title: "Go for the 60 Trillion Won Submarine Project" Dosan Ahn Chang-ho Submarine Arrives in Canada (“60조원 잠수함 사업 따자” 도산안창호함, 캐나다 입항)
item.description:
"Go for the 60 Trillion Won Submarine Project" Dosan Ahn Chang-ho Submarine Arrives in Canada (“60조원 잠수함 사업 따자” 도산안창호함, 캐나다 입항)

Our Navy's diesel submarine, the Dosan Ahn Chang-ho (3,000-ton class), has become the first domestically built submarine to cross the Pacific Ocean and arrive in Canada. It set a record for the longest voyage ever by a locally made submarine, covering approximately 14,000 km one way, demonstrating its long-range operational capabilities. The Navy is providing 'fire support' for the bid to win Canada's submarine procurement project, which is reportedly valued at up to 60 trillion won. (우리 해군 디젤 잠수함 도산안창호함(3000t급)이 국산 잠수함 중 처음으로 태평양을 횡단해 캐나다에 입항했다. 국산 잠수함으로는 역대 최장 항해 기록인 편도 약 1만4000㎞를 기록하면서 장거리 작전 능력을 입증했다. 최대 60조원 규모로 알려진 캐나다 잠수함 수주전을 위한 해군이 ‘화력 지원’에 나선 것이다.)

According to the Navy, the Dosan Ahn Chang-ho arrived at the Canadian Forces Base Esquimalt in Victoria, western Canada, on the 23rd (local time). This comes about two months after it departed from Jinhae Naval Base on March 25th to cross the Pacific. A Navy official stated, "While Korean submarines have previously reached Hawaii, this is the first time one has crossed the Pacific Ocean," adding, "By traveling via Guam and Hawaii to Victoria, it has proven the long-endurance mission capability of our locally built submarines." The Dosan Ahn Chang-ho is known to have top-tier living convenience in its class. From the time of its departure from Hawaii, two crew members from the Canadian Navy's Submarine Command embarked on the Dosan Ahn Chang-ho, communicating with the Canadian Pacific Command while participating in the voyage. <<> At the official arrival ceremony scheduled for the 25th, Navy Chief of Staff Admiral Kim Gyung-ryul and Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA) Commissioner Lee Yong-chul will attend to support the bid for Canada's submarine project. Admiral Kim previously met on the 23rd in Ottawa with Vice Admiral Angus Topshee, Commander of the Royal Canadian Navy, who has been nominated as the next Deputy Minister of National Defence for Canada, introducing the Dosan Ahn Chang-ho's operational capabilities and the whole-of-government support plans if Korea's submarines are selected. After conducting joint exercises with the Canadian Navy locally, the Dosan Ahn Chang-ho will participate in the U.S.-led multinational maritime exercise RIMPAC in Hawaii. <<> Canada is carrying out the 'Canadian Patrol Submarine Project (CPSP)' to introduce up to 12 diesel submarines to replace its four Victoria-class submarines scheduled for retirement in the mid-2030s. The project scale is reported to be up to 60 trillion won. A consortium of South Korea's Hanwha Ocean and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries is in the final competition with Germany's ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems. The results are expected to be announced as early as next month. A defense industry official said, "Until early this year, there were many analyses that Germany had an overwhelming advantage, but now the mood is that we have a fighting chance." (해군에 따르면 도산안창호함은 23일(현지 시각) 캐나다 서부 빅토리아 에스퀴몰트 기지에 입항했다. 지난 3월 25일 진해 군항을 출항해 태평양 횡단에 나선 지 약 두 달 만이다. 해군 관계자는 “한국 잠수함이 하와이까진 갔었지만 태평양을 횡단한 것은 이번이 처음”이라며 “괌·하와이를 거쳐 빅토리아까지 가면서 국산 잠수함의 장기간 임무 수행 능력을 입증했다”고 했다. 도산안창호함은 동급 최고 수준의 거주 편의성을 갖춘 것으로 알려졌다. 하와이 출항 시점부터는 캐나다 해군 잠수함사령부 소속 승조원 2명이 편승해 도산안창호함에서 캐나다 태평양사령부와 교신하며 항해에 동참했다.)

item.title: 'Busan North Gap': Ha Jung-woo 35%, Han Dong-hoon 36%, Park Min-shik 19% (‘부산 북갑’ 하정우 35% 한동훈 36% 박민식 19%)
item.description:
'Busan North Gap': Ha Jung-woo 35%, Han Dong-hoon 36%, Park Min-shik 19% (‘부산 북갑’ 하정우 35% 한동훈 36% 박민식 19% )

In the by-election for the Busan North Gap National Assembly seat, held concurrently with the June 3 local elections, a new poll shows Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon in a tight race within the margin of error. The analysis indicates a solidifying two-strong, one-middle structure in North Gap. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 더불어민주당 하정우 후보와 무소속 한동훈 후보가 오차 범위 내에서 초접전을 벌이고 있다는 조사 결과가 또 나왔다. 북갑에서 2강 1중의 구도가 굳어지고 있는 것으로 분석된다.)

A survey conducted by Gallup Korea on behalf of Segye Ilbo on the 21st and 22nd, released on the 24th, showed Democratic Party candidate Ha receiving 35% support, independent candidate Han receiving 36%, putting them neck-and-neck within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). Support for People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik stood at 19%. (여론조사 회사 한국갤럽이 세계일보 의뢰로 21~22일 실시해 24일 공개한 조사에서 민주당 하 후보가 35%, 무소속 한 후보가 36%의 지지를 얻어 오차 범위(±4.4%포인트) 내에서 박빙인 것으로 나타났다. 국민의힘 박민식 후보를 지지한다는 응답은 19%로 나타났다.)

In hypothetical two-way matchups assuming conservative unification, Ha Jung-woo got 48% and Park Min-shik 36%, while Ha Jung-woo got 41% and Han Dong-hoon 45%. This survey was conducted via wireless telephone interviews with 502 voters in the Busan North Gap district. When asked about their views on unification, 66% of People Power Party supporters expressed approval. (보수 단일화를 전제로 한 가상 양자 대결에서는 하정우 후보 48%·박민식 후보 36%였고, 하정우 후보 41%·한동훈 후보 45%였다. 이번 조사는 부산 북갑 지역 유권자 502명을 대상으로 무선 전화 면접 방식으로 실시됐다. 단일화에 대한 견해를 묻는 질문에는 국민의힘 지지자의 66%가 찬성한다고 답했다.)

Earlier, a survey by Research & Research on behalf of Channel A conducted from the 17th to the 19th on support for the Busan North Gap National Assembly by-election showed Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo at 32.9%, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik at 20.5%, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon at 34.6%. A wireless telephone interview survey commissioned by Chosun Ilbo and conducted by Matrix from the 16th to the 17th with 501 voters in Busan North Gap showed Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo with 39%, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik with 20%, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon with 33% support. (앞서 여론조사 회사 리서치앤리서치가 채널A 의뢰로 지난 17~19일 실시한 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 지지도 조사에서 더불어민주당 하정우 후보는 32.9%, 국민의힘 박민식 후보는 20.5%, 무소속 한동훈 후보는 34.6%로 나타났다. 조선일보 의뢰로 메트릭스가 지난 16~17일 부산 북갑 지역 유권자 501명을 대상으로 실시한 무선 전화 면접 조사에서는 더불어민주당 하정우 후보 39%, 국민의힘 박민식 후보 20%, 무소속 한동훈 후보가 33%의 지지도를 얻었다.)

In the five-candidate by-election in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, a survey found Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam at 30%, People Power Party candidate Yoo Ui-dong at 23%, and Cho Kuk Innovation Party candidate Cho Kuk at 25%, with the three candidates in a tight race within the margin of error. Liberty and Innovation candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn recorded 8% support, and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon recorded 3%. (이 밖에 5자 구도로 치러지고 있는 경기 평택을 재선거에서는 더불어민주당 김용남 후보가 30%, 국민의힘 유의동 후보가 23%, 조국혁신당 조국 후보가 25%의 지지율로 3명의 후보가 오차 범위 내에서 접전을 벌이고 있는 것으로 조사됐다. 자유와혁신 황교안 후보는 8%, 진보당 김재연 후보는 3%의 지지를 기록했다.)

In hypothetical two-way matchups assuming unification between the Democratic Party and the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, Kim Yong-nam led Yoo Ui-dong 51% to 36%, and Cho Kuk led Yoo Ui-dong 49% to 38%, with Kim and Cho both ahead of the People Power Party candidate outside the margin of error. (민주당과 조국혁신당의 단일화를 전제로 한 가상 양자 대결에서는 김용남 후보 51%·유의동 후보 36%, 조국 후보 49%·유의동 후보 38%로 김·조 후보가 국민의힘 유 후보를 오차 범위 밖에서 앞섰다.)

In Gyeonggi Hanam-gap, Democratic Party candidate Lee Kwang-jae received 49% support, leading People Power Party candidate Lee Yong (33%) outside the margin of error. The proportion of respondents supporting Reform Party candidate Kim Sung-yul was 2%. (경기 하남갑의 경우 민주당 이광재 후보가 49%로 국민의힘 이용 후보(33%)를 오차 범위 밖에서 앞섰다. 개혁신당 김성열 후보를 지지한다고 답한 응답자의 비율은 2%였다.)

item.title: North Korean Football Team Leaves After Propaganda of 'Hostile Two-State' Despite Unification Ministry's Efforts (통일부 공들였지만… ‘적대적 두 국가’ 선전하고 간 北축구)
item.description:
North Korean Football Team Leaves After Propaganda of 'Hostile Two-State' Despite Unification Ministry's Efforts (통일부 공들였지만… ‘적대적 두 국가’ 선전하고 간 北축구)

The North Korean women’s football club team "Naegohyang Women's Football Team," which visited the South to attend the semifinals and finals of the 2025–2026 Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League (AWCL), won the championship on the 23rd. However, they stormed out of a press conference after expressing dissatisfaction with a South Korean journalist who used the terms "northern side" or "north side" instead of "Democratic People's Republic of Korea." North Korean media outlets such as the Korean Central News Agency reported the team's victory on the 24th, but made no mention of the final being held in Suwon or the joint cheering squad organized by South Korean civilian groups to support the North Korean team. Previously, the Unification Ministry had provided 300 million won from the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund to the groups that organized the cheering squad. <<> This marks the first visit of a North Korean athlete delegation to the South since North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un defined inter-Korean relations as "hostile two-state relations" at the end of 2023. The visit ending in discord is seen as foreshadowing a bleak outlook for inter-Korean relations. Kim Jong-un stated in his policy address to the Supreme People's Assembly in March, "We will officially recognize South Korea as the most hostile state and deal with it thoroughly through the clearest words and actions, by rejecting and ignoring it." <<> The Unification Ministry announced that the Naegohyang Women's Football Team departed from Incheon Airport at 3:30 PM on the 24th via an Air China flight to Beijing, China, after completing their 7-day, 6-night visit to the South. The team, which entered the South via China on the 17th, defeated Suwon FC Wimin 2-1 in the AWCL semifinals held at Suwon Sports Complex on the 20th. They then won the championship on the 23rd by beating Japan's Tokyo Verdy Beleza 1-0 at the same venue. <<> The championship press conference included Naegohyang Women's Football Team head coach Ri Yu-il, MVP Kim Kyong-yong, and a team interpreter. The issue arose when a South Korean journalist said, "The women's football from the northern side (bukjjok) and north side (bukcheuk) has always been of very high quality." Coach Ri raised his hand and said, "Please correct your title," and the team interpreter added, "Please use the correct national name." Player Kim sitting next to them said, "We are the Democratic People's Republic of Korea." After exchanging brief words, the three immediately stood up and left the press conference. <<> Since the first inter-Korean contact in August 1971, when Red Cross liaison officers met after the division, the two sides have referred to each other as "south side" and "north side" in inter-Korean talks, finding a compromise among various titles. The Naegohyang team's strong reaction to this established terminology is analyzed as stemming from Kim Jong-un's declaration of "hostile two-state relations." After Kim defined inter-Korean relations as "belligerent state relations," North Korea has referred to the South as the "Republic of Korea" or "South Korea" and described inter-Korean relations as "DPRK-ROK relations" (in Korean, Jojoseon-Hanguk relations). <<> Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young, who advocates for "peaceful two-state relations," stated in his New Year's address at the ministry's inauguration ceremony on January 2, "The Lee Jae-myung government respects the system of the 'Democratic People's Republic of Korea.'" He has since referred to North Korea as "Democratic People's Republic of Korea" or "Joseon" and described inter-Korean relations as "Hanguk-Joseon relations." However, critics point out that recognizing the two as separate states and using North Korea's constitutional name, "Democratic People's Republic of Korea," conflicts with South Korea's constitution. Article 3 of the Constitution states, "The territory of the Republic of Korea shall consist of the Korean Peninsula and its adjacent islands," and Article 4 states, "The Republic of Korea seeks unification." <<> The government officially uses the term "North Korea" (Bukhan). President Lee Jae-myung has also referred to North Korea as "Bukhan" or "bukcheuk" since his inauguration. However, in a post on X (formerly Twitter) on the 23rd, President Lee did not use terms like "Bukhan" and only said, "I extend heartfelt congratulations to the Naegohyang Women's Football Team players who won the championship," adding, "The ball is round, and we will meet again." (2025~2026시즌 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스리그(AWCL) 준결승·결승전 참석을 위해 방남(訪南)한 북한의 여자 축구 클럽팀 ‘내고향여자축구단’이 23일 우승을 차지했지만, 우리 기자가 ‘조선민주주의인민공화국’이 아니라 ‘북쪽’ ‘북측’이란 표현을 사용한 데 불만을 드러내며 기자회견장을 박차고 나갔다. 조선중앙통신 등 북한 매체들은 24일 내고향여자축구단의 우승 사실을 보도했지만, 결승전이 수원에서 열렸으며 우리 민간 단체들이 공동 응원단을 만들어 북한팀도 응원한 사실은 전혀 보도하지 않았다. 앞서 통일부는 응원단을 조직한 단체들에 남북교류협력기금 3억원을 지원했다.)

item.title: Just Before Ulsan Unification Results, Kim Sang-wook Says: “Primary Suspended… Evidence of Organized Interference” (울산 단일화 결과 발표 직전, 與김상욱 “경선 중단… 조직적 개입 정황”)
item.description:
Just Before Ulsan Unification Results, Kim Sang-wook Says: “Primary Suspended… Evidence of Organized Interference” (울산 단일화 결과 발표 직전, 與김상욱 “경선 중단… 조직적 개입 정황”)

The primary election for the pan-ruling camp’s unification of Ulsan mayoral candidates, being conducted by the Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party, has been suspended. Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook said on the 24th, targeting Progressive Party candidate Kim Jong-hoon, “Evidence of organized interference has been found.” Candidate Kim Jong-hoon’s side responded, saying, “This is unacceptable,” and added, “It violates the spirit of the unification agreement and cannot be tolerated.” Earlier, both parties had agreed on a primary method using a two-day, 100% opinion poll on the 23rd and 24th, with the results scheduled to be announced on that day. (더불어민주당과 진보당이 진행 중인 범여권 울산시장 후보 단일화를 위한 경선이 중단됐다. 민주당 김상욱 후보는 24일 진보당 김종훈 후보를 겨냥해 “조직적인 개입 정황이 발견됐다”고 했다. 김종훈 후보 측은 “납득할 수 없다”며 “단일화 합의 정신을 어기는 것으로 용납할 수 없다”고 반발했다. 앞서 양당은 23~24일 양일간의 100% 여론조사를 통한 경선 방식에 합의했고 이날 결과 발표가 예정돼 있었다.)

In a press conference that day, candidate Kim stated, “The polling agency discovered irregularities and suspended the survey,” adding, “During the poll, patterns beyond what is typically predictable were found, showing very anomalous trends.” He went on to say, “We, who had adhered to the standard of ‘a method free from opinion distortion,’ have concluded that continuing the primary in the current manner is no longer possible,” and “This is because an anti-democratic situation is emerging where citizens’ right to choose could be infringed upon by the machinations of certain forces.” (김 후보는 이날 기자회견에서 “여론조사 기관이 특이사항을 발견해 조사를 중단했다”며 “여론조사 중 통상 예측할 수 있는 수준을 넘어 매우 변칙적 흐름을 보이는 정황이 발견됐다고 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “‘여론 왜곡이 없는 방식’을 기준으로 했던 저희는 더 이상 현재 방식으로 경선이 불가능하다는 결론에 이르렀다”면서 “특정 세력 농간에 시민 선택권이 침해받을 반민주적 상황이 도래되기 때문”이라고 했다.)

However, he indicated that the unification itself was not being withdrawn. Candidate Kim said, “We will not stop the unification process through follow-up consultations.” Secretary General Cho Seung-rae also stated in the press conference, “The Ulsan City Party and Kim Sang-wook’s side appropriately suspended the process given the circumstances,” and “The will for unification remains clear.” (다만 단일화 자체를 철회하는 것은 아니라고 했다. 김 후보는 “후속 협의를 해 단일화 걸음을 멈추지 않겠다”고 했다. 조승래 사무총장도 회견에서 “울산시당과 김상욱 후보 측이 사정을 고려해 적절히 중단한 것”이라며 “단일화 의지는 여전히 분명하다”고 했다.)

The Progressive Party reacted strongly. Candidate Kim Jong-hoon said in a statement, “The Progressive Party has identified no irregularities,” and “We have not received any confirmed evidence regarding what interference occurred.” The Progressive Party added, “We express strong regret over this unilateral declaration, which does not align with citizens’ demands to eradicate insurrection.” The Progressive Party revealed that out of the two opinion polls being conducted for unification, the one conducted by the Democratic Party was suspended that day, while only the Progressive Party’s poll was completed. This means the polls, which were to be carried out separately by each party and then combined, were halted in an incomplete state. <<> Amid this, People Power Party Ulsan mayoral candidate Kim Doo-gyeom called for conservative unification with independent candidate Park Maeng-woo on that day. Candidates for Ulsan city council seats from the People Power Party even performed a 108-bow ritual in front of candidate Park’s office. Candidate Park, however, has drawn a line on unification, stating, “This is not feasible in terms of timing or reality,” making conservative camp unification another key variable in the final stage of the Ulsan election. (진보당은 반발했다. 김종훈 후보는 입장문에서 “진보당은 특이한 점을 파악한 것이 없다”면서 “개입된 게 뭔지 확인된 근거를 통보받은 바가 없다”고 했다. 진보당은 “내란을 청산하라는 시민 요구에 맞지 않는 일방적 선언에 강력한 유감을 표한다”고 했다. 진보당 측은 단일화를 위해 진행된 여론 조사 2곳 가운데 민주당이 실시한 여론 조사는 이날 중단되고, 진보당의 여론조사만 마무리됐다고 밝혔다. 양당이 각각 실시해 종합하려던 여론조사가 불완전한 상태로 중단된 것이다.)

item.title: In 'Loan Shark Allegations' with Kim Yong-nam, Cho Kuk's Side Says "Reconsider Your Position"... Kim: "Completely Untrue" (與김용남 ‘대부업 의혹’ 조국측 “거취 숙고하라”… 金 “전혀 사실 아니다”)
item.description:
In 'Loan Shark Allegations' with Kim Yong-nam, Cho Kuk's Side Says "Reconsider Your Position"... Kim: "Completely Untrue" (與김용남 ‘대부업 의혹’ 조국측 “거취 숙고하라”… 金 “전혀 사실 아니다”)

The Pyeongtaek-eul by-election for the National Assembly is witnessing intense tensions among pro-government candidates. On the 24th, Cho Kuk, candidate of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, launched an attack on Kim Yong-nam, candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea, by bringing forward allegations that Kim operated a loan shark business under a borrowed name. Kim countered, saying, "It's not true." Within the ruling camp, there are comments that "the possibility of a unified candidacy between the two is gradually disappearing." <<> On the 23rd, at a memorial ceremony for former President Roh Moo-hyun, candidate Cho met with reporters and said of Kim's allegations, "These allegations about candidate Kim will not only affect the Pyeongtaek-eul election but also cast a negative shadow over the entire democratic reform camp." Earlier, Cho's camp stated, "Evidence has emerged that candidate Kim operated a loan shark business under a borrowed name through an agricultural corporation he owns." The claim is that Kim, acting as a proxy operator, extracted profits from the loan shark business through dividends. Shin Jang-sik, a lawmaker from the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, said, "Candidate Kim should reconsider his position, and the Democratic Party should conduct an ethics audit." Previously, the Cho Kuk Innovation Party had also demanded Kim's resignation over allegations of assaulting his aides during his time as a lawmaker. Jang Dong-hyuk, acting leader of the People Power Party, also targeted Kim, a former Saenuri Party member who joined the Democratic Party last year, on Facebook, stating, "He betrayed and fled, but it turns out he was one of the 'Loan Shark Brothers.'" <<> Candidate Kim responded, "This is completely untrue. The establishment and operation of the company in question were all carried out normally in accordance with legal procedures." Cho Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party, said at a press conference, addressing candidate Cho's demands for an audit of Kim, "There is a line of propriety among comrades. Keep that line. We will audit, verify, and check things ourselves." <<> The Pyeongtaek-eul race is unfolding with five candidates: Kim, Cho, Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party, Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party, and Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party. Amid this, a tense battle of nerves is ongoing between Kim and Cho, the pro-government candidates vying for the lead. According to a public opinion survey conducted by Segye Ilbo in collaboration with Gallup Korea from the 21st to the 22nd, via telephone interviews of 500 voters in the Pyeongtaek-eul district, the results released on this day showed support rates of 30% for Kim Yong-nam, 23% for Yoo Ui-dong, 25% for Cho Kuk, 8% for Hwang Kyo-ahn, and 3% for Kim Jae-yeon. For more details, refer to the Central Election Public Opinion Survey Review Committee. (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거는 범여권 후보 간 신경전이 치열하다. 24일에는 조국혁신당 조국 후보 측이 더불어민주당 김용남 후보의 대부업체 차명 운영 의혹을 전면에 내세워 김 후보를 공격했다. 김 후보는 “사실이 아니다”라고 반박했다. 여권에선 “두 후보 간 단일화 가능성이 점차 사라지고 있다”는 말이 나왔다.)

item.title: North Chungcheong’s Undecided Voters Drop from 35% to 14%… Close Battle Within Margin of Error Between Shin Yong-han and Kim Young-hwan (충북 부동층 35%→14%… 신용한·김영환 오차범위 격전)
item.description:
North Chungcheong’s Undecided Voters Drop from 35% to 14%… Close Battle Within Margin of Error Between Shin Yong-han and Kim Young-hwan (충북 부동층 35%→14%… 신용한·김영환 오차범위 격전)

“People in this neighborhood are hard to read. But after the votes are counted, you see a big change.” (“이 동네 사람들은 속을 몰라유. 근데 투표 끝나고 보면 확 바뀌어 있는겨.”)

On the 23rd, Kim Seong-ja (58), met at Cheongju’s Yukgeori Traditional Market, the largest traditional market in North Chungcheong Province, said regarding the June 3rd North Chungcheong governor election, “I’m still thinking about who to vote for.” (지난 23일 충북 최대 전통시장인 청주 육거리 종합시장에서 만난 김성자(58)씨는 6·3 충북지사 선거와 관련해 “누굴 찍을지 아직도 고민 중”이라고 했다.)

In this North Chungcheong gubernatorial election, Shin Yong-han (57), former Vice Chairman of the Presidential Committee for Local Era from the Democratic Party of Korea, and incumbent Governor Kim Young-hwan (71) from the People Power Party are competing. Early in the campaign, opinion polls showed former Vice Chairman Shin leading Governor Kim by a double-digit margin, but recently some polls have shown the gap narrowing to within the margin of error. Amid this, former President Park Geun-hye is scheduled to visit North Chungcheong on the 25th to support Governor Kim, leading to expectations that the final phase of the election could become a chaotic race. (이번 충북지사 선거에선 더불어민주당 신용한(57) 전 지방시대위원회 부위원장과 국민의힘 김영환(71) 현 지사가 맞붙는다. 선거전 초반 지지도 조사에서 신 전 부위원장이 김 지사를 두 자릿수 차이로 앞섰지만 최근엔 두 사람 간 지지도 격차가 오차 범위 내로 줄어든 조사 결과도 나왔다. 이런 가운데 박근혜 전 대통령이 25일 충북을 찾아 김 지사 지원에 나설 것으로 알려져, 막판 선거 판세가 혼전 양상을 보일 수 있다는 전망이 나온다.)

Former Vice Chairman Shin became the candidate after defeating former Presidential Chief of Staff Noh Young-min in the Democratic Party primaries. Shin, a former CEO of a venture investment firm, has pledged to promote a “special startup province of North Chungcheong,” attract public institutions like the Korea Airports Corporation, and start early construction of the Jungbu Region Express Railway (JTX). Governor Kim was initially excluded from the People Power Party primaries due to allegations of bribery, but after a new primary process, he became the candidate. His pledges include building a 50,000-seat domed stadium in Osong, Cheongju, and completing an “AI (Artificial Intelligence) Special Province of North Chungcheong.” (신 전 부위원장은 민주당 경선에서 노영민 전 청와대 비서실장을 누르고 후보가 됐다. 창업 투자사 대표 출신인 신 후보는 ‘창업 특별도 충북’ 추진, 한국공항공사 등 공공기관 유치, 중부권광역급행철도(JTX) 조기 착공 등을 공약했다. 김 지사는 ‘금품 수수 의혹’으로 국민의힘에서 컷오프(경선 배제)됐다가 다시 경선을 치른 끝에 후보가 됐다. 청주 오송에 5만석 규모 돔구장 건설, ‘AI(인공지능) 충북특별도 완성’ 등 공약을 내걸었다.)

Earlier, a poll conducted by K-Stat Research (commissioned by KBS Cheongju Broadcasting Station) from the 13th to the 15th targeting 5,520 North Chungcheong residents (via telephone interviews) showed candidate Shin at 37% and candidate Kim at 25%. The proportion of respondents who said they had no candidate or didn’t know (undecided voters) was 35%. The poll’s margin of error was ±1.3 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. However, in a poll conducted by Realmeter (commissioned by NewsPim) from the 20th to the 21st targeting 804 North Chungcheong residents (via ARS), candidate Shin received 45.4% and candidate Kim 40.8%. The gap was within the margin of error. The proportion of undecided voters was 13.8%. The poll’s margin of error was ±3.5 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission) <<> Local political circles analyze that “the support gap between the two candidates is narrowing as the undecided voters, which exceeded 30%, are making their choices.” Professor Emeritus Eom Tae-seok of Seowon University said, “Voters in North Chungcheong tend to carefully evaluate the political situation and candidate competitiveness until the very end,” adding, “I believe the election outcome could change significantly depending on the sentiments of undecided voters.” <<> Park Sang-jun (48), met in Ochang-eup, Cheongju, said, “We need to support candidate Shin Yong-han so that the new government can work effectively.” In contrast, Kim Seon-young (65), a resident of Gagyeong-dong, Cheongju, stated, “I think candidate Kim Young-hwan, who has experience promoting projects like the ‘Working Meal Server’ and ‘Urban Farmer,’ is the right person.” <<> Amid this, former President Park Geun-hye plans to visit the birthplace of her late mother, Yuk Young-soo, in Okcheon, North Chungcheong, on the 25th. Candidate Kim Young-hwan is also expected to attend this event. On the 23rd, former President Park visited Daegu’s Chilseong Market with People Power Party’s Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho, effectively engaging in election support. <<> Former President Park reportedly plans to meet with People Power Party’s Daejeon mayoral candidate Lee Jang-woo (61) on the same day. Additionally, Park will meet with People Power Party’s South Chungcheong governor candidate Kim Tae-heum and visit Gongju’s Sangsung Market together. Candidate Lee, the current mayor, is a pro-Park figure who opposed the National Assembly’s impeachment motion against former President Park in 2016. Former President Park is said to have stated, “I want to encourage Candidate Lee, who remained loyal until the end.” <<> In the Daejeon mayoral election, the Democratic Party has fielded former Mayor Heo Tae-jeong (60). This is the second time he faces Candidate Lee Jang-woo, following the 2022 local elections. Candidate Heo, a former Roh Moo-hyun administration presidential secretary, served as Yuseong-gu district chief in Daejeon before being elected Daejeon mayor in 2018. From the Reform Party, Gang Hee-rin (29), chairperson of the Daejeon party chapter, has entered the race. item.title: Ruling party candidates fail to answer 'who is the main enemy' question (‘주적은 누구’ 질문에 답 못하는 與 후보들)
item.description:
Ruling party candidates fail to answer 'who is the main enemy' question (‘주적은 누구’ 질문에 답 못하는 與 후보들)

Candidates of the Democratic Party of Korea running in the June 3 local elections are facing controversy for failing to properly answer the question, "Who is the main enemy of the Republic of Korea?" The People Power Party said, "If an elected public official cannot even state their security stance, it is a deception of the public." The Democratic Party countered, calling it a "dichotomous ideological war." <<> Ha Jeong-woo, the Democratic Party candidate for the Busan North-Gap by-election, did not answer when a YouTuber asked on the 22nd, "Is North Korea the main enemy of the Republic of Korea?" instead responding, "Is it appropriate to ask this while campaigning?" Pressed further, Ha replied, "It is stated in the defense white paper." The defense white paper had removed the phrase designating North Korea as the main enemy during the Moon Jae-in administration but reinstated it under the Yoon Suk-yeol government. People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik said, "Ha's security stance is completely broken," adding, "How can someone who cannot say a single word about North Korea, a nuclear-armed group threatening our lives, become a member of the National Assembly?" Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon also stated, "North Korea is clearly our main enemy," adding, "Doesn't Candidate Ha have his own opinions?" <<> A video of Democratic Party Incheon mayoral candidate Park Chan-dae being asked by a student on the 16th about the main enemy and replying, "Isn't it the insurrection forces?" has spread on YouTube. In response, People Power Party Incheon mayoral candidate Yoo Jeong-bok's camp said, "They concealed the true enemy, North Korea." Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh also did not answer questions about the main enemy, with footage shared on social media. Democratic Party Ulsan mayoral candidate Kim Sang-wook sparked controversy on the 6th during his YouTube live broadcast by saying, "If North Korea does not threaten our people's lives and our democracy, perhaps there's no need to regard it as a main enemy." <<> The security stance debate flares up with every election. The most notable controversy occurred during the 2017 presidential election TV debate when then-Democratic Party candidate, former President Moon Jae-in, was asked, "Is North Korea the main enemy?" and responded, "I don't think it's the president's role to make such a designation." People Power Party spokesperson Park Seong-hoon criticized in a commentary, "Democratic Party candidates cannot even state from whom the Republic of Korea's military defends the country." (6·3 지방선거에 출마한 더불어민주당 후보들이 ‘대한민국 주적(主敵)이 누구냐’를 묻는 질문에 제대로 답변하지 못해 논란이 되고 있다. 국민의힘은 “선출직 공직자가 안보관도 밝히지 못한다면 대국민 기만”이라고 했다. 민주당은 “이분법적 이념 전쟁”이라고 맞받았다.)

item.title: “Still, the Democratic Party will vote for Lee Won-taek” vs “I’ll vote for Kim Gwan-young, whom Jeong Cheong-rae ousted” (“그래도 민주당, 이원택 뽑을 것” vs “정청래가 내친 김관영 찍겠다”)
item.description:
“Still, the Democratic Party will vote for Lee Won-taek” vs “I’ll vote for Kim Gwan-young, whom Jeong Cheong-rae ousted” (“그래도 민주당, 이원택 뽑을 것” vs “정청래가 내친 김관영 찍겠다”)

“It’s a Democratic administration, so we should vote for the Democratic candidate.” (“민주당 정권인데 민주당 후보를 뽑아야지.”)

“What nonsense. Jeong Cheong-rae cut Kim Gwan-young to push in his own person.” <<> With the June 3 local elections just ten days away on the 24th, residents of North Jeolla Province whom this newspaper met in Jeonju, Iksan, Gunsan, and Wanju were sharply divided between supporting Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek and independent candidate Kim Gwan-young, who was expelled from the Democratic Party over the “designated driver fee payment controversy.” There has been no precedent in Honam, a traditional Democratic stronghold, for an independent candidate to win a metropolitan mayoral election. As such, the North Jeolla election, which has emerged as the biggest battleground within the ruling camp, remained a tight race as of this day. <<> Those leaning toward backing Lee Won-taek placed emphasis on the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. Seong Mo (46), a shopkeeper in Jeonju’s Wansan-gu, said, “Still, it’s the Democratic Party,” adding, “I naturally lean toward Lee, the Democratic candidate.” Kim Mo (44), who sells food at Iksan’s Northern Market, remarked, “Shouldn’t we vote for the ruling party to work with the government and achieve results?” <<> Supporters of Lee often cited the allegations of designated driver fee payments against Kim Gwan-young, who is seeking re-election, with many reacting that “a politician shouldn’t do that.” Lee In-ro (70), a resident of Iksan’s Yeongdeung-dong, said, “I don’t understand why someone who should know better would do such a thing,” adding, “And then he blames Jeong Cheong-rae?” Han Seon-gyu (68), a taxi driver in Iksan, also said, “People who try to buy voters with money should be pushed out of politics.” Jeon Cheol-seong (78), a farmer in Jeonju, noted, “Kim’s popularity dropped a lot during the Saemangeum Jamboree. Jeonju was globally embarrassed,” and added, “Lee is someone who has worked for North Jeolla,” referring to Lee’s background as a former provincial vice-governor. <<> However, a significant number of people said they would vote for Kim, citing that the Democratic Party leadership under Jeong Cheong-rae expelled him on the day of the report without even hearing his explanation regarding the designated driver fee payment controversy. In particular, there were criticisms that the Democratic Party’s conclusion of “no suspicions” for Lee Won-taek, who is close to Jeong Cheong-rae, over an alleged “meal payment proxy” issue was unfair. Lee Mo (64), met at a park in Jeonju, said, “They should have applied the same standard to both; you can’t just expel one person,” adding, “This time, I’ll vote for Kim Gwan-young for the sake of continuity in provincial administration.” Jeon Hyeok (72), a resident of Iksan’s Eoyang-dong, argued, “If a guest comes from far away, you might pay for their designated driver fee, right?” and said, “They overlooked Lee Won-taek’s meal payment proxy, didn’t give Kim Gwan-young a chance to explain, and just booted him. Jeong Cheong-rae (the Democratic Party leader) did that to make his own person the governor.” <<> Still, many residents said they had yet to make up their minds. Kim Mo (34), an office worker living in Iksan’s Mohyeon-dong, identified as a Democratic Party dues-paying member but said, “The Democratic Party’s handling of Kim Gwan-young was wrong,” adding, “Still, I’m wondering if I should vote for the ruling party candidate, so I’m torn.” Kim Mo (55), a paper craft artist in Jeonju, also said, “I’m a Democratic Party member and enjoy listening to Kim Eo-joon’s broadcasts, but I haven’t decided who to vote for.” <<> The two candidates have been swapping first and second place within the margin of error in recent polls. In a wireless telephone ARS survey conducted by Saejeonbuk Newspaper and HanGil Research from the 30th of last month to the 1st of this month, Lee Won-taek led with 39.6% to Kim Gwan-young’s 36.6%, a 3.0 percentage point (p) gap. However, in a survey conducted on the 16th to 17th, Kim took the lead with 42.1% to Lee’s 40.5%, a 1.6%p lead. In a wireless telephone ARS survey by News1 and JoWon C&I on the 9th to 10th, Kim led with 43.2% to Lee’s 39.7%, a 3.5%p gap. But in a wireless telephone interview survey by KBS Jeonju and Embrain Public on the 18th to 20th, Lee led with 39% to Kim’s 37%, a 2%p lead. For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website. (“무슨 소리여. 정청래가 지 사람 꽂으려고 김관영 자른 건데.”)

item.title: Jung Won-oh: "Even During the Sampoong Disaster, It Was a Rebar Issue" Oh Se-hoon: "Let's Have a One-on-One Debate at Samseong Station" (정원오 “삼풍 참사 때도 철근 문제” 오세훈 “삼성역서 양자 토론하자”)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh: "Even During the Sampoong Disaster, It Was a Rebar Issue" Oh Se-hoon: "Let's Have a One-on-One Debate at Samseong Station" (정원오 “삼풍 참사 때도 철근 문제” 오세훈 “삼성역서 양자 토론하자”)

Democratic Party of Korea mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh and People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon are engaged in a fierce verbal battle over the partial omission of rebar at the GTX-A Samseong Station construction site. Candidate Jung emphasized the suspicion of poor construction under "Oh Se-hoon's Seoul administration," calling it "an administration numb to safety." He even brought up the "Sampoong Department Store collapse disaster." However, candidate Oh countered, "Do not stir up public anxiety with unfounded rumors." He then challenged Jung, who only agreed to one televised debate, saying, "Let's have a one-on-one debate at Samseong Station." <<> On the 24th, candidate Jung stated, "One of the main causes of the Sampoong Department Store collapse was half-installed rebar," and added, "It's reported that 2,570 rebars were missing at GTX-A Samseong Station. This is construction with only half the rebar." The previous day, Jung also asked, "Why do major accidents keep happening only during Mayor Oh Se-hoon's tenure—like the Yongsan disaster, the Itaewon disaster, the Gangnam Station semi-basement flooding disaster, and the Sungnyemun arson? If coincidences repeat, it becomes inevitability." <<> On the 23rd, candidate Oh remarked, "With President Lee Jae-myung's help, you're inflating rebar rumors to stir public anxiety, which seems to be (Candidate Jung's) election strategy. I won't fall for it." In response to Jung's call to visit the Samseong Station construction site, Oh said, "If Candidate Jung promises to be there and engage in a discussion on safety issues, I will go to Samseong Station." <<> Currently, the Democratic Party is fiercely attacking Oh over the discovery that some columns in Section 3 of the 5th basement level at the GTX-A Samseong Station, constructed by Hyundai Engineering & Construction, have only one rebar instead of the required two. President Lee has also directed the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety to investigate the situation. Meanwhile, the Seoul Metropolitan Government claims it repeatedly reported the rebar omission issue to the Korea National Railway, which failed to properly review it, and that the city has since taken relevant procedures and measures on its own. <<> On the 24th, candidates Jung and Oh attended the Buddha's Birthday celebration ceremony at Jogyesa Temple in Jongno-gu, Seoul, side by side. In his message that day, Jung stated, "I will create a 'Safe Special City Seoul,'" while Oh said, "I will improve the 'quality of life' for Seoul's 10 million citizens." item.title: Starbucks Controversy Stirs Up Election Campaign (스타벅스 논란, 선거판 휘젓다)
item.description:
Starbucks Controversy Stirs Up Election Campaign (스타벅스 논란, 선거판 휘젓다)

President Lee Jae-myung posted another critical message on X (formerly Twitter) on the 23rd, targeting Starbucks Korea for sparking controversy with its "Tank Day" marketing on the May 18th commemoration day. This time, he shared a post by Democratic Party lawmaker Jeong Jin-uk, who claimed that Starbucks Korea launched a "Siren Mug" on April 16, 2024, the day of the Sewol ferry disaster remembrance, saying, "Wearing a human mask, this is utterly unacceptable conduct." (5·18 기념일에 ‘탱크데이’ 마케팅을 진행해 논란을 자초한 스타벅스코리아에 대해 이재명 대통령이 23일 X(옛 트위터)에 또다시 비난 글을 올렸다. 이번에는 스타벅스코리아가 세월호 참사 추모일인 2024년 4월 16일 ‘사이렌 머그잔’을 출시했다는 정진욱 민주당 의원의 글을 공유하면서 “인두겁을 쓰고서는 도저히 할 수 있는 일이 아니다”라고 했다.)

The allegation is that using the mythical siren—a creature that lures ships to wreckage with its song—in marketing mocked the Sewol ferry victims. However, Starbucks has used the siren in its company logo since its founding in 1971. Even political figures critical of the "Tank Day" marketing on May 18th have reacted that linking the "Siren Mug" to mocking the Sewol disaster is "excessive." Shinsegae Group Chairman Chung Yong-jin decided to issue a direct apology to the public on the 26th. (노래로 배를 난파시키는 신화 속 요정 사이렌을 마케팅에 활용해 세월호 희생자들을 조롱했다는 것이다. 하지만 스타벅스는 1971년 창립 때부터 사이렌을 회사 로고에 사용해왔다. 5·18에 진행한 ‘탱크데이’ 마케팅에 대해 비판적인 정치권 인사들도 ‘사이렌 머그잔’을 세월호 참사 조롱으로 연결시킨 것에 대해선 “과도하다”는 반응이다. 신세계그룹 정용진 회장은 26일 직접 대국민 사과문을 발표하기로 했다.)

On the 18th, President Lee publicly criticized Starbucks Korea's "Tank Day" marketing, saying, "I am outraged by the inhumane, outrageous behavior of low-class merchants." This served as a catalyst for the government and ruling party's "Starbucks bashing." (지난 18일 이 대통령은 스타벅스코리아의 ‘탱크데이’ 마케팅에 대해 “저질 장사치의 비인간적 막장 행태에 분노한다”고 공개 비판했다. 이는 정부와 여권의 ‘스타벅스 때리기’에 기폭제가 됐다.)

The Ministry of the Interior and Safety announced a halt to the use of Starbucks gift certificates, and the Ministry of SMEs and Startups reviewed whether to revoke the Prime Minister's Commendation that Starbucks Korea received last November. The police assigned a case of insult and defamation against Chairman Chung Yong-jin to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency and began an investigation. The Democratic Party also issued a "Starbucks use restraint order" to local election candidates, and Representative Jeong Cheong-rae stated, "A boycott of Starbucks will spread like wildfire, centering on Gwangju," while pushing for a "May 18 Mockery Prohibition Act." (행정안전부는 스타벅스 상품권 사용 중단을 선언했고, 중소벤처기업부는 스타벅스코리아가 작년 11월 받은 국무총리 표창의 취소 여부를 검토했다. 경찰은 정용진 회장에 대한 모욕·명예훼손 고발 건을 서울경찰청에 배당하고 수사에 착수했다. 민주당도 지방선거 후보들에게 ‘스타벅스 이용 자제령’을 내렸고, 정청래 대표는 “광주를 중심으로 스타벅스 불매운동이 요원의 불길처럼 번질 것”이라면서 ‘5·18 조롱 금지법’을 추진하겠다고 했다.)

Amid this, President Lee's post suggesting that the "Siren Mug" mocked the Sewol ferry disaster led to analysis from the opposition that he aims to "galvanize the Democratic Party's support base, including in the Honam region, by dividing voters ahead of the local elections." (이런 가운데 이 대통령이 ‘사이렌 머그잔’이 세월호 참사 조롱이라는 취지의 글까지 올리자, 야권을 중심으로 “지방선거를 앞두고 유권자를 갈라치기하면서 호남 등 민주당 지지층을 결집시키려는 의도”라는 분석이 제기됐다.)

On the 24th, President Lee posted on X about reviewing the closure of the internet community site "Ilbe," known for its far-right content. He said, "Public discussion and review are needed on allowing measures such as closure, punitive damages, and fines under strict conditions for sites like Ilbe that allow or foster mockery and hatred." The "Ilbe closure" was also considered during the Moon Jae-in administration in 2018 but was abandoned due to legal impossibility. An opposition source said, "Bringing up 'Ilbe closure' again seems like a similar tactic to 'Starbucks bashing.'" (이 대통령은 24일에는 극우 성향의 글이 많이 올라오는 인터넷 커뮤니티 사이트 ‘일간베스트(일베)’의 폐쇄를 검토하자는 글을 X에 올렸다. 이 대통령은 “일베처럼 조롱·혐오를 방치 및 조장하는 사이트의 폐쇄·징벌적 손해배상·과징금 등 필요한 조치를 엄격한 조건 아래 허용하는 데 대한 공론화와 검토가 필요하다”고 했다. ‘일베 폐쇄’는 2018년 문재인 정부 때도 검토했지만, 법률상 불가능했기 때문에 중단했다. 야권 관계자는 “‘일베 폐쇄’를 다시 꺼낸 것도 ‘스타벅스 때리기’와 같은 차원인 것 같다”고 했다.)

◇Lee: "Review Closure of Ilbe Site" Opposition: "Gathering Support Base?" (◇李 “일베 사이트 폐쇄 검토” 野 “지지층 모으나”)

The political world noted President Lee Jae-myung's direct involvement in "creating issues." On the 21st, while ordering coffee at a visit to Ikseon-dong Hanok Street in Seoul, President Lee "sniped" at Starbucks, asking, "That's not coffee from there, is it?" He also made provocative remarks such as, "How can you wear a human mask and do that?" (at a cabinet meeting on the 20th), and "There will be public judgment for this beastly behavior of routinely demeaning victims of state violence and disasters just to make some money" (on X on the 23rd). Ruling party figures also interpreted this as aimed at the support base, including in the Honam region. (정치권에서는 이재명 대통령이 직접 ‘이슈화’에 나선 것을 주목했다. 이 대통령은 21일 서울 익선동 한옥거리를 찾은 자리에서 커피를 주문하며 “거기 커피 아니지요?”라고 스타벅스를 ‘저격’했다. “어떻게 사람의 탈을 쓰고 그럴 수 있나”(20일 국무회의), “돈 좀 벌겠다고 상습적으로 국가폭력과 참사 희생자들을 능멸하는 이 금수같은 행태에 국민적 심판이 있을 것”(23일 X에서) 같은 자극적인 언급도 있었다. 여권 인사들도 호남 등 지지층을 염두에 둔 것으로 해석했다.)

The Democratic Party said it would amend the May 18 Special Act, which currently only punishes the spread of false information, to include acts that defame or insult victims, their families, and related individuals. The People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy on the 24th urged the National Pension Service, which holds shares in E-Mart (the largest shareholder of Starbucks' operator), to demand improvement measures to ensure corporate social responsibility. (민주당은 허위 사실 유포만 처벌하는 5·18 특별법을 개정해 희생자, 유족, 관련자 등의 명예를 훼손하거나 모욕하는 행위까지 처벌 대상에 포함시키겠다고 했다. 참여연대는 24일 스타벅스 운영사의 최대 주주인 이마트 지분을 보유한 국민연금을 향해 “기업이 사회적 책임을 다하도록 개선 대책을 요구하라”고 했다.)

The controversy over "Tank Day marketing" is beginning to emerge as a local election issue. In the case of Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh, he declared participation in the Starbucks boycott movement in line with President Lee and the party leadership's stance. (‘탱크데이 마케팅’을 둘러싼 논란은 지방선거 이슈로 떠오르기 시작했다. 민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보의 경우, 이 대통령과 당 지도부 기조에 맞춰 스타벅스 불매 운동 동참을 선언했다.)

In contrast, the People Power Party criticized it as "excessive corporate bashing." People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, "President Lee has lost his reason," adding, "The siren is Starbucks' symbol, but (President Lee) lashed out recklessly without even checking properly." Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon stated, "Starbucks clearly made a mistake. There's no excuse, but they've been hit enough now," while Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon's camp criticized it as "excessive intervention bordering on killing a corporation." Independent candidate for Busan's North Gap district, Han Dong-hoon, asked, "Is the Democratic Party's main enemy North Korea or Starbucks?" (반면 국민의힘은 “지나친 기업 때리기”라고 비판하고 나섰다. 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 “이 대통령이 이성을 상실했다”며 “사이렌은 스타벅스의 상징인데 (이 대통령이) 제대로 알아보지도 않고 앞뒤 없이 지른다”고 했다. 오세훈 서울시장 후보는 “스타벅스는 분명 잘못했다. 변명의 여지가 없지만 이 정도 때렸으면 됐다”고 했고, 박형준 부산시장 후보 측은 “기업 죽이기에 가까운 과도한 개입”이라고 비판했다. 무소속 한동훈 부산 북갑 후보는 “민주당의 주적은 북한이 아니라 스타벅스냐”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the ruling and opposition parties also clashed over the "Ilbe closure" issue on that day. Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said, "If movements beyond common sense are structurally repeated, it's right to consider closure." In contrast, Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok retorted, "The more you target a minor target with public power, the more that target will gain a martyr's halo." (한편, 여야는 이날 ‘일베 폐쇄’를 놓고도 공방을 벌였다. 민주당 조승래 사무총장은 “상식적 수준을 뛰어넘는 움직임이 구조적으로 반복되고 있다면 폐쇄도 검토하는 게 맞는다”고 했다. 반면 이준석 개혁신당 대표는 “미미한 표적을 공적인 권력으로 계속 겨눌수록 그 표적은 순교자의 후광을 얻을 것”이라고 반박했다.)

Legal circles predict that an actual Ilbe closure would be difficult. A former presiding judge turned lawyer said, "To close a specific site, the proportion of illegal content on that site must be overwhelming. Going beyond blocking illegal posts to completely shutting down the site would likely lead to controversy over violating constitutional freedom of expression." (법조계에선 실제 일베 폐쇄는 어려울 것이란 전망이 나온다. 부장판사 출신 변호사는 “특정 사이트를 폐쇄하려면 해당 사이트 글 중 불법 정보의 비율이 압도적이어야 한다”면서 “위법한 글을 차단하는 수준을 넘어 사이트를 통째로 폐쇄할 경우 헌법상 표현의 자유 침해 논란으로도 이어질 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: The Biggest Variable in Local Elections: 'Undecided Voters'… If They Vote, Who Actually Benefits? (지방선거 최대 변수 ‘무당층’…그들이 투표하면 과연 누가 유리할까)
item.description:
The 9th nationwide simultaneous local elections on June 3 are just around the corner. Though it is an election to select grassroots leaders who will shape the future of local autonomy, it has taken on the guise of a proxy war for central politics, escalating into an all-out battle for the fate of the ruling and opposition parties. A social big data analysis compiled by SomeTrend over the past three weeks (May 1–21) starkly reveals the key variables churning beneath the surface of public sentiment. The ultimate factor determining a candidate's victory or defeat in this election is not simply the sum of party approval ratings. Three pillars forming the core of big data associated keywords—'undecided voters (swing voters),' 'TV debates,' and 'voter turnout'—are emerging as decisive keys that could shake up the race in the final stages. (제9회 6·3 전국동시지방선거가 코앞으로 다가왔다. 지방자치의 미래를 책임질 풀뿌리 일꾼을 뽑는 선거이지만, 중앙 정치의 대리전 양상을 띠며 여야의 명운을 건 한판 승부로 번지고 있다. 썸트렌드(SomeTrend)가 최근 3주간(5월 1~21일) 집계한 소셜 빅데이터 분석 결과는 민심의 수면 아래에서 소용돌이치고 있는 핵심 변수들을 극명하게 보여준다. 이번 선거에서 후보자의 당락을 결정할 최종 변수는 단순한 정당 지지율의 총합이 아니다. 빅데이터 연관어의 중핵을 구성하는 세 기둥, 즉 ‘무당층(부동층)’, ‘TV 토론’, 그리고 ‘투표율’의 상호작용이 선거 막판 판세를 뒤흔들 결정적 열쇠로 부상하고 있다.)

Local elections are fundamentally a stage where regionally focused public sentiment and macro-level political dynamics interplay in complex ways. Examining the big data keywords associated with local elections, 'education' (superintendent of education elections), 'autonomy,' and 'promises' are key links to 'local elections.' This proves that voters are paying attention not only to elections for mayors and governors of cities and provinces, as well as district and county heads, but also to the intrinsic value of educational administration and 'promises' that include the specificity of pledge implementation. (지방선거는 기본적으로 지역 밀착형 민심과 거시적 정치 구도가 복합적으로 작용하는 무대다. 빅데이터 지방선거 연관어를 살펴보면 ‘지방선거’의 핵심 고리로 ‘교육’(교육감 선거), ‘자치’, ‘약속’ 등이 꼽힌다. 이는 유권자들이 시·도지사 및 구·시·군장 선거뿐만 아니라 교육행정 본연의 가치와 공약 이행의 구체성을 담은 ‘약속’에 주목하고 있음을 방증한다.)

Keywords associated with 'undecided voters' in the big data analysis are highly suggestive. Words appearing in connection with the polling agency 'Realmeter'—such as 'record high,' 'pollster,' 'respondent,' 'figure,' and 'rate'—reflect that the proportion of undecided voters in recent party approval ratings has soared to unprecedented levels. As moderate and undecided voters, fatigued by the extreme confrontational politics between the two parties, increase, depending on which direction they shift rapidly in the final phase of the election, the outcome in battlegrounds will be determined by microscopic 'point' differences, creating a classic 'swing voter' political landscape. (빅데이터 분석에서 ‘무당층’과 결합한 연관어들은 매우 시사적이다. 여론조사 기관 ‘리얼미터’와 연계되어 나타난 ‘최고치’, ‘조사원’, ‘응답자’, ‘수치’, ‘비율’ 등의 단어는 최근 정당 지지율 조사에서 무당층 비율이 역대급 수준으로 치솟았음을 대변한다. 양당의 극단적 대치 정국에 피로감을 느낀 중도파 및 무당층 유권자가 늘어나면서, 이들이 선거 종반 어느 방향으로 급격히 이동하느냐에 따라 격전지의 미세한 ‘포인트’ 차 당락이 결정될 전형적인 ‘스윙 보터(Swing Voter)’ 정국이다.)

In the history of South Korean elections, a representative case where a massive swing of undecided voters overturned the landscape was the 20th general election in 2016. A landslide victory for the ruling party was predicted right up until the election, but a huge wave of undecided and moderate voters, disappointed by the ruling party's nomination turmoil, rapidly shifted to the opposition parties (the Democratic Party of Korea and the People's Party) in the final stage, leading to a shocking reversal resulting in a 'minority ruling party, majority opposition' structure. Undecided voters may remain silent in opinion poll figures, but they have consistently demonstrated their most formidable explosive power inside the ballot box. (한국 선거사에서 무당층의 대규모 쏠림이 판세를 뒤집은 대표적 사례는 2016년 제20대 총선을 꼽을 수 있다. 선거 직전까지 집권 여당의 압승이 예상되었으나, 여당의 공천 파동에 실망한 거대한 무당층과 중도층이 선거 막판 야당(더불어민주당 및 국민의당)으로 급격히 선회하면서 ‘여소야대’라는 충격적인 반전 결과를 낳았다. 무당층은 여론조사 수치상으로는 침묵하지만, 투표함 속에서 가장 무서운 폭발력을 발휘해 왔다.)

In the big data sentiment analysis of associated keywords, the 'TV debate' area is overwhelmingly dominated by a negative atmosphere. Words like 'criticism,' 'criticize,' 'concern,' and 'controversy' are prevalent, along with judicial risk verification terms such as 'bribery,' 'false information,' 'assault,' 'crime,' and 'allegation' ranking high. Additionally, keywords like 'refuse,' 'insufficient,' and 'bed-soccer'—a term criticizing candidates who avoid substance and merely kill time—have emerged. This reflects voters' deep disappointment with the current debate culture, where policy confrontations are absent and only mutual slander and negative attacks remain. (빅데이터 감성 연관어 분석에서 ‘TV토론’ 영역은 철저히 부정적 기류가 압도하고 있다. ‘비판’, ‘비판하다’, ‘우려’, ‘논란’ 등의 단어는 물론이고, ‘금품수수’, ‘허위사실’, ‘폭행’, ‘범죄’, ‘의혹’과 같은 사법적 리스크 검증 단어들이 상위를 차지했다. 또한 토론을 회피하거나 시간만 때우려는 행태를 꼬집는 ‘거부하다’, ‘부족하다’, ‘침대축구’라는 단어까지 연관어로 등장했다. 이는 정책 대결이 실종되고 상호 비방과 네거티브 공방만이 남은 현재의 토론 문화에 대한 유권자들의 깊은 실망감을 투영한다.)

However, even within this mudslinging, TV debates remain a decisive variable. Historically, the 15th presidential election in 1997 was a watershed moment where TV debates determined election success or failure. In the first full-fledged candidate TV debate in South Korean electoral history, candidate Kim Dae-jung instantly dispelled the negative image long imposed on him by conservative media through his extensive knowledge and composed debate demeanor. This became a critical catalyst for absorbing moderate undecided voters and achieving the first peaceful transfer of power in history. Conversely, if debates devolve into 'bed-soccer' or exposés of 'allegations,' as in this election, it could backfire by fueling political aversion and prompting undecided voters to abandon voting altogether. (그러나 이러한 진흙탕 공방 속에서도 TV토론은 결정적 변수가 된다. 역사적으로 1997년 제15대 대선은 TV 토론이 선거 성패를 가른 분수령이었다. 한국 선거 사상 최초로 도입된 본격 대선 후보 TV 토론에서, 당시 김대중 후보는 오랜 기간 보수 언론 등에 의해 덧씌워졌던 부정적 이미지를 해박한 식견과 안정감 있는 토론 태도를 통해 단숨에 불식시켰다. 이는 중도파 무당층을 흡수해 사상 첫 평화적 정권 교체를 이루는 결정적 계기가 되었다. 반면, 이번 선거처럼 토론이 ‘침대 축구’나 ‘의혹’ 폭로전으로 점철될 경우, 유권자의 정치 혐오를 부추겨 무당층의 투표 포기를 유발하는 역효과를 낼 수도 있다.)

In contrast, the atmosphere of big data sentiment words related to 'voter turnout' is quite different. Alongside participatory and positive words like 'recognition,' 'hope,' 'trust,' and 'encourage,' strategically positioned words such as 'strength,' 'traditional,' 'contribute,' 'active,' 'favorable,' and 'landslide victory' appear. This shows that voter turnout is a core driver defining the causal relationship of election outcomes. Each camp is precisely calculating the 'impact' that small fluctuations in turnout would bring to them, actively 'encouraging' their supporters to vote. Meanwhile, the appearance of concern-laden big data keywords like 'confusion' or 'election fraud' indicates heightened sensitivity regarding the transparency and fairness of the voting process. (반면, ‘투표율’과 관련된 빅데이터 감성어는 분위기가 사뭇 다르다. ‘인지도’, ‘희망’, ‘신뢰’, ‘독려하다’와 같이 참여적이고 긍정적인 단어들과 더불어, 구조적으로는 ‘강세’, ‘전통적’, ‘기여하다’, ‘적극적’, ‘유리하다’, ‘압승’ 등의 전략적 단어들이 포진해 있다. 투표율이 선거 결과의 인과적 관계를 규정하는 최고의 핵심 동력임을 보여준다. 각 진영은 투표율의 소폭 변동이 자신들에게 가져올 ‘영향력’을 정밀 계산하며 지지층의 ‘적극적’ 투표를 ‘독려’하고 있다. 한편으로 ‘혼란’이나 ‘부정선거’ 같은 우려 섞인 빅데이터 연관어가 등장하는 것은 투표 과정의 투명성과 공정성에 대한 민감성이 그만큼 높아졌음을 뜻한다.)

A prime example of the power of voter turnout in past elections is the 21st general election in 2020. Despite the COVID-19 pandemic crisis, a 66.2% turnout—the highest in 28 years—was recorded, and this, combined with the 'active' participation of moderates and younger generations wanting to bolster crisis response, resulted in the ruling party's 'landslide victory' of 180 seats. This case reaffirmed the political formula: low turnout favors camps with strong organizational power, while high turnout reflects the total volume of hidden public sentiment, creating a massive wave. (역대 선거에서 투표율의 위력을 보여준 대표적인 예는 2020년 제21대 총선이다. 코로나19 팬데믹이라는 위기 속에서도 28년 만에 최고치인 66.2%의 투표율을 기록했고, 이는 위기 극복에 힘을 실어주려는 중도층과 젊은 층의 ‘적극적’ 참여가 결합하면서 여당의 180석 ‘압승’으로 귀결되었다. 투표율이 낮으면 조직력이 강한 진영이 ‘유리’하고, 투표율이 높으면 숨어 있던 민심의 전체 총량이 반영되어 거대한 파도를 만든다는 정치 공식이 다시 한 번 입증된 사례다.)

In the current two-party structure, voter turnout and the direction of undecided voters are subject to self-serving interpretations. The People Power Party relies on the concrete cohesion of its 'traditional' support base and its solid local organizational strength. In TV debates, it employs tactics to actively 'criticize' the opposing candidate's allegations of 'bribery' or 'false information,' aiming to redirect undecided voters' focus toward the ruling party's perceived moral flaws. If the final mudslinging maximizes political aversion, leading to a drop in overall turnout, the calculation is that the People Power Party is relatively 'favorable' in the electoral arena. (현재 양당 구조에서 투표율과 무당층의 향배는 아전인수격 해석의 대상이다. 국민의힘은 ‘전통적’ 지지층의 콘크리트 결집과 견고한 지방 조직력을 신뢰하고 있다. TV 토론에서 상대 후보의 ‘금품 수수’나 ‘허위 사실’ 의혹을 적극 ‘비판’함으로써 무당층의 눈을 여당의 도덕성 결함으로 돌리려는 전술을 구사한다. 만약 막판 공방으로 정치 혐오가 극대화되어 전체 투표율이 하락한다면, 상대적으로 국민의힘이 선거판에서 ‘유리하다’는 계산이 선다.)

On the other hand, the Democratic Party of Korea aims to structure a 'landslide victory' by riding on high party approval ratings and voters' favorable evaluation of the president's 'performance of state affairs.' To draw out the 'record high' number of undecided voters to the polls, it emphasizes policy 'promises' and future visions, strongly 'encouraging' voting participation. When voter turnout rises above a certain level, the Democratic Party's 'influence' is likely to be maximized. (반면, 더불어민주당은 높은 정당 지지율과 대통령 ‘국정수행’에 대한 유권자들의 우호적 평가 흐름을 타고 ‘압승’의 구조를 짜려 한다. ‘최고치’에 달한 무당층을 투표소로 끌어내기 위해 정책적 ‘약속’과 미래 비전을 강조하며 투표 참여를 강력히 ‘독려’하고 있다. 투표율이 일정 수준 이상 상승할 때 민주당의 ‘영향력’이 극대화될 가능성이 크다.)

The generational dynamics are even more diverse. In this election, the generation accounting for the largest 'proportion' of 'undecided voters' is none other than the 2030 youth cohort. They show the lowest loyalty to established parties and are highly sensitive to candidate 'recognition' and emotional factors through social media and online platforms. Disappointed by sensational news like 'assault,' 'crime,' and 'controversy' erupting from TV debates, they might largely abandon voting, but conversely, if captivated by fresh policy values, they possess the fluidity to rapidly transform into an 'active' voting block. (세대별 역학은 더욱 다채롭다. 이번 선거에서 ‘무당층’의 가장 큰 ‘비율’을 차지하는 세대는 다름 아닌 2030 청년 세대이다. 이들은 기성 정당에 대한 충성도가 가장 낮으며, SNS와 온라인을 통한 후보 ‘인지도’와 감성적 요인에 민감하게 반응한다. TV 토론에서 터져 나오는 ‘폭행’ ‘범죄’ ‘논란’ 등 자극적인 뉴스에 실망해 대거 투표를 포기할 수도 있지만, 반대로 참신한 정책적 가치에 매료될 경우 ‘적극적’ 투표층으로 급반전할 수 있는 유동성을 지닌다.)

In contrast, the 4050 generation exhibits clear voting tendencies based on reform and evaluation of the incumbent government, and they are traditionally the backbone with high voter participation rates. Even amidst negative attacks in TV debates, they tend to strongly sift through the essence of substantial allegations and serve as a key driver of increased voter turnout. Finally, the 6070+ senior cohort values stability and the 'traditional' values of the conservative camp; they are highly likely to 'push back' against the chaos of debates and rally to the polls to maintain the 'strength' of their camp. Ultimately, the voter turnout of the 2030 undecided voters will be the watershed deciding final victory or defeat in the intergenerational showdown. (반면 4050 세대는 개혁성과 정권 평가에 기반한 투표 성향이 뚜렷하며, 투표 참여율이 전통적으로 높은 허리층이다. 이들은 TV 토론의 네거티브 공방 속에서도 본질적인 의혹의 실체를 가려내려는 성향이 강하며, 투표율 상승의 핵심 견인차 역할을 한다. 마지막으로 6070+ 고령층은 안정과 보수 진영의 ‘전통적’ 가치를 중시하며, 토론회의 혼란상에 ‘반발’해 진영의 ‘강세’를 유지하기 위해 투표소로 결집할 확률이 매우 높다. 결국 2030 무당층의 투표율이 최종 세대 간 대결의 승패를 가를 분수령이다.)

The stern warning from big data ahead of the June 3 local elections is clear. Voters are expressing extreme fatigue and 'concern' over the substandard mudslinging in the ongoing campaign, which is leading to political cynicism and forming a vast curtain of 'undecided voters.' To draw public sentiment—trapped by political circles in a mudfight—back to the public square, they must stop 'bed-soccer' avoidance and restore responsible 'promises.' (6·3 지방선거를 목전에 둔 빅데이터의 엄중한 경고는 명확하다. 유권자들은 현재 진행 중인 선거 운동의 수준 이하 공방에 극심한 피로감과 ‘우려’를 표명하고 있으며, 이것이 정치적 냉소로 이어져 거대한 ‘무당층’의 장막을 형성하고 있다는 점이다. 정치권이 진흙탕 싸움 속에 가두려 하는 민심을 다시 광장으로 이끌어내려면 ‘침대축구’식 회피를 멈추고 책임 있는 ‘약속’을 복원해야 한다.)

Voter turnout is not merely a record of 'figures' and 'rates'; it is a measure of democratic health. Only when a virtuous cycle is established—restoring the 'hope' and 'trust' of public sentiment and genuinely vetting candidates' true capabilities—will the 'record high' number of undecided voters finally break their silence and head to the polls. Only parties and candidates that clear away the darkness of negativity and lead to active voter participation can achieve a true 'landslide victory' and a win for local autonomy on the night of June 3. (투표율은 단순한 ‘수치’와 ‘비율’의 기록이 아니라, 민주주의의 건강성을 측정하는 척도다. 민심의 ‘희망’과 ‘신뢰’를 회복하고 후보자의 진짜 역량을 검증해 내는 선순환이 이루어질 때, 역대 ‘최고치’에 달한 무당층은 비로소 침묵을 깨고 투표소로 향할 것이다. 네거티브의 어둠을 걷어내고 유권자의 적극적인 참여를 이끌어내는 정당과 후보만이 6월 3일 밤, 진정한 의미의 ‘압승’과 지방자치의 승리를 거머쥘 수 있다.)

item.title: The Truth in the Velvet Case (벨벳 케이스 속의 진실)
item.description:
Dudael Tech Korea Branch was located about five kilometers from the rear gate of Camp Humphreys in Pyeongtaek. Only the employees who entered the building knew that the concrete box sitting on an open, flat expanse was the Dudael Tech Korea Branch. (듀다엘 테크 한국 지사는 평택 캠프 험프리스 후문에서 약 5㎞ 떨어진 곳에 자리 잡고 있었다. 사방이 트인 개활지 위에 놓인 콘크리트 상자가 듀다엘 테크 한국 지사라는 사실을 아는 사람은 이 건물에 출입하는 직원들뿐이었다.)

Evan took a short break and looked outside from the office window. The three-story gray building sat alone, with no signboard or fence. The view was always blurry through the glass reinforced with metal mesh. Out on the distant farm road, a red tractor that must have been over thirty years old rumbled slowly by. The hunched back of an old man riding the tractor looked like an exotic scene to him. (에반은 잠시 휴식 차 사무실 창가에서 바깥을 바라봤다. 3층짜리 회색 건물이 덩그러니 놓인 이곳엔 간판도, 울타리도 없었다. 금속 망사가 덧대어진 유리창 탓에 풍경은 늘 흐릿했다. 저 멀리 논길 위로, 30년은 넘었을 법한 빨간색 트랙터 한 대가 털털거리며 느릿하게 지나갔다. 트랙터에 몸을 실은 노인의 구부정한 뒷모습이 그에겐 이국적인 풍경이었다.)

Realizing how much time had passed, Evan hurried back to his seat. Then, he couldn't take his eyes off the email sent from headquarters. (에반은 시간이 꽤나 흐른 것을 깨닫자 서둘러 제자리로 돌아가 앉았다. 그리곤, 본사에서 보낸 이메일에서 눈을 떼지 못했다.)

[HQ Guideline] ([HQ Guideline])

· Security Level: Top Secret (· 보안 등급: Top Secret)

· Directive: No transfer of technology, including source code. (· 지침: 소스 코드 등 기술 이전 불가.)

· Objective: Limit local partnerships to a level that maintains strategic optics. (· 목표: 현지 파트너십은 전략적 모양새(optics)를 갖추는 수준으로 제한.)

It had been the same screen for thirty minutes. Headquarters' instructions were clear. That clarity made negotiations with the Korean government difficult. The stress built up to the point where he could no longer remember the cold wind of London or the scent of martini Irina had left behind. (30분째 같은 화면이었다. 본사의 지시는 명확했다. 그 명확함이 한국 정부와의 협상을 어렵게 만들었다. 스트레스가 쌓인 탓에 런던의 찬 바람도, 이리나가 남긴 마티니 향도 더는 기억나지 않을 지경이었다.)

"Staring at it like that, did ChatGPT develop a feature to draft proposals for you?" (“그렇게 뚫어져라 쳐다보면/ 챗GPT가 /제안서라도 대신 써주는 기능이 생긴건가”)

A low, smooth Eastern accent came from behind. It was Jeff Ballinger, the head of Dudael Korea Branch. Through black rimless glasses, his eyes blinked with a strangely offbeat rhythm. He looked fine on the outside, but there was something malfunctioning in his software. His off-the-rack suit couldn't quite hide a slightly protruding belly. Without permission, Jeff perched on the edge of Evan's desk and casually waved the tablet in his hand. (등 뒤에서 낮고 매끄러운 동부 억양이 들려왔다. 듀다엘 한국 지사장 제프 밸린저였다. 검은 무테 안경 너머로, 박자가 묘하게 어긋난 채 깜빡이는 눈이 보였다. 겉은 멀쩡해 보이지만 어딘가 소프트웨어가 오작동하는 사람이었다. 기성품 티가 나는 정장은 살짝 튀어나온 뱃살을 끝내 감추지 못했다. 제프는 에반의 책상 모서리에 허락도 없이 걸터앉으며 손에 든 태블릿을 무심하게 흔들었다.)

"You'd better drop that naive hope that AI will give you the answers. Get out there and think of a way. Since HQ has no intention of giving away a single line of source code, and the Korean government won't budge without technology transfer, maybe you should go and try begging or something?" (“AI가 당신 대신 답을 내려줄 거라는 순진한 기대는 접는 게 좋을 거야. 발로 뛰면서 방법을 좀 생각해봐. 어차피 본사는 소스 코드 한 줄도 줄 생각은 없고, 한국 정부는 기술 이전 없이는 움직일 생각이 없다고 하니, 가서 뭐 빌기라도 해봐야 하는 것 아닌가?”)

"There is a way." Evan didn't stop typing. "The Korean military authorities are showing interest in a live demonstration. If we let them see the performance directly, it could create a loophole to bypass the technology transfer conditions." (“방법은 있습니다.” 에반의 타이핑이 멈추지 않았다. “한국 군 당국이 실전 시연에 관심을 보이고 있습니다. 성능을 직접 확인시키면 기술 이전 조건을 우회할 여지가 생길 겁니다.”)

"A live demonstration." Jeff looked down at Evan over his glasses. He seemed to enjoy looking down from above Evan's seated head. "I hope it works out as you say. But, you know—" (“실전 시연이라.” 제프가 안경 너머로 에반을 내려다보았다. 앉아 있는 에반의 머리 위에서 내려다보는 각도를 즐기는 것 같았다. “당신 말대로 되면 좋겠군. 하지만 말이야”)

Jeff tapped Evan's personnel record with the tablet. (제프가 태블릿으로 에반의 인사 기록을 툭툭 건드렸다.)

"Sometimes I really wonder how a friend with such a complicated background keeps up our security clearance. Though I guess the Pentagon is still a bit obsessed with diversity." (“가끔 정말 궁금해져. 당신처럼 복잡한 배경을 가진 친구가 어떻게 우리 비밀취급인가를 유지하고 있는 건지. 아직도 펜타곤이 다양성에 좀 집착하는 편이긴 하지만.”)

Jeff added a slight smile to the word 'diversity.' (제프는 ‘다양성’이라는 단어에 살짝 미소를 얹었다.)

"Seeing you stuck out here in this backwater without even a family yet, I can't tell if you really like this job or if you have nowhere else to go." (“아직 가정도 없이 이 시골구석에 처박혀 있는 거 보면, 이 일이 정말 좋은 건지 다른 데 갈 곳이 없는 건지 헷갈리더라고.”)

Evan didn't stop typing. He didn't want to respond, but after a beat, he opened his mouth. (에반은 타이핑을 멈추지 않았다. 굳이 대꾸하고 싶지 않았지만, 한 박자 뒤에 입을 열었다.)

"If the Pentagon security team suspected me, they wouldn't have assigned me the core work of Sariel. I appreciate you worrying about my personal life, but isn't what a branch director should focus on this year's order performance, not my personnel record?" (“펜타곤 보안팀이 절 의심했다면, 사리엘의 핵심 실무를 저한테 맡기지 않았겠죠. 제 사생활까지 걱정해 주시는 건 고맙지만, 지사장님이 신경 쓸 건 제 인사 기록이 아니라 올해 수주 실적 아닐까요.”)

Jeff's eyelid twitched slightly. But he maintained his smile expertly, adjusting his glasses. (제프의 눈꺼풀이 미세하게 떨렸다. 하지만 그는 노련하게 웃음을 유지하며 안경을 고쳐 썼다.)

When it came down to it, Evan's performance was Jeff's record too. That fact only twisted Jeff's mood further. (따지고 보면 에반의 성과가 곧 제프의 실적이었다. 그런 사실이 제프의 심사를 더 뒤틀리게 만들었다.)

"Wow, look at the claws come out. Cute." Jeff tapped Evan's monitor with his finger. "Don't get me wrong. I'm giving you advice because I care about you." (“워, 발톱 세우는 것 좀 봐. 귀엽군.” 제프는 에반의 모니터를 손가락으로 톡 건드렸다. “오해는 말아. 당신을 생각해서 하는 조언이니까.”)

Jeff stood up and patted Evan's shoulder. A friendly gesture typical of American executives, but one that didn't bother to control its force. (제프는 몸을 일으키며 에반의 어깨를 툭 쳤다. 미국 간부 특유의 다정한 손짓, 그러나 힘 조절 따위는 하지 않는 손길이었다.)

"But Evan, let's get one thing straight. Even if my KPI is zero dollars, I can enjoy the rest of my life in some resort in Thailand or the Philippines. But your situation is a bit different, isn't it?" (“그런데 에반, 한 가지는 확실히 해두자. 난 KPI가 0달러라도 어디 태국이든 필리핀이든 휴양지에서 남은 생을 즐기겠지만, 당신 상황은 좀 다르지 않겠어?”)

Jeff walked toward his office and continued speaking with his back turned. (제프가 집무실을 향해 걸으며 등을 돌린 채 말을 이었다.)

"I'm one of your multi-rater evaluators. Whether your career ends here or your name stays on the payroll next month depends on the tip of my pen." (“난 당신 다면 평가자 중 한 명이야. 당신 커리어가 여기서 마침표를 찍을지, 다음 달에도 급여 명부에 이름을 올릴 수 있을지는 내 펜 끝에 달려 있어.”)

Jeff stopped at the door and only turned his head. His smiling eyes behind the glasses carried a strange unpleasantness. (제프가 문 앞에서 멈추고 고개만 돌렸다. 안경 너머의 웃고 있는 눈매가 묘한 불쾌감을 자아냈다.)

"So, go ahead and bring me that brilliant proposal. Something magical that satisfies the Korean government's childish 'K-everything' desires while giving away not a single letter of our algorithm. This will be your chance to prove whether you're a core asset of this company or just an 'ethnic liaison' who chats with the Koreans." (“자, 그럼 어디 그 잘난 제안서 한번 가져와 봐. 한국 정부의 K 어쩌구 하는 유치한 욕구도 채워주면서 우리 알고리즘은 단 한 글자도 안 내주는 마법 같은 제안서가 좋겠군. 당신이 이 회사의 핵심 자산인지, 아니면 한국인들이랑 말이나 섞어주는 ‘에스닉 리에종(ethnic liaison)’에 불과한지. 이번에 확실히 증명해 볼 기회겠네.”)

Jeff disappeared into his office. Silence fell over the office again. In a corner of Evan's monitor screen, Jeff's fingerprint glistened. Evan wiped the smudge away with his sleeve. Slowly, twice. The world beyond the metal-mesh glass remained blurry. When Evan looked out the window again, the red tractor on the farm road was already gone. (제프가 집무실로 사라졌다. 사무실에 다시 정적이 내려앉았다. 에반의 모니터 화면 한구석에 제프의 지문이 번들거렸다. 에반은 소매 끝으로 그 자국을 닦아냈다. 천천히, 두 번. 금속 망사 유리 너머의 세계는 여전히 흐릿했다. 에반이 다시 창밖을 보았을 때, 논길 위의 빨간 트랙터는 이미 사라지고 없었다.)

Evan turned his gaze back to the monitor. Headquarters' guidelines were still unchanged. He stared at them for a long time, then reached into his desk drawer. Deep in the drawer, his fingertips touched an old velvet case. The texture of the rough fabric transmitted to his fingertips. (에반은 모니터로 시선을 돌렸다. 본사의 가이드라인은 여전히 바뀐 것이 없다. 그는 한참을 들여다보다가, 책상 서랍에 손을 넣었다. 서랍 깊숙한 곳, 낡은 벨벳 케이스 위에 손끝이 닿았다. 거친 천의 감촉이 손가락 끝에 전해졌다.)

Evan didn't take out the case. He only rested his fingertips on it for a moment, then closed the drawer. (에반은 케이스를 꺼내지 않았다. 손끝만 잠시 그 위에 얹어두었다가, 서랍을 닫았다.)
